facts.business: Optimus Finance Limited is a Non-Deposit taking NBFC primarily engaged in loans, investments, and trading in marketable securities and mutual funds, with subsidiaries in lubricant manufacturing and infrastructure.

capacity_or_capex.item: Maximus Group consolidated manufacturing capacity for lubricants and specialty oils/chemicals

key_risks: Substantial exposure in corporate deposits of Rs. 1534.84 Lakhs forming a substantial portion of net worth
facts.related_party_note: Transactions include salary to KMPs (Dipak Raval Rs. 41.58 Lakhs, Vruti Surti Rs. 4.13 Lakhs), interest income from Maximus International Limited (Rs. 11.57 Lakhs), Sukruti Infratech Private Limited (Rs. 29.44 Lakhs), and Maximus Infra Ventures Limited.
